Context: Recovery:

## Recovery:  
Recovery should commence with issue of pay for the month following the one in which the advance was drawn, e.g., for advance drawn in April,  
recovery should commence from pay for May payable on 31st May.  
- Rule 13 (2).  
When balance of the previous advance is consolidated with the amount of new advance, the recovery of previous advance will continue till the next month and the recovery against the consolidated amount commences thereafter. - GID (8), Rule 12.
